ValidationRule.description: This rule requires a lead in Contacted/Call Back status to also have an appointment date and time.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Status , "Contacted/Call Back") , ISNULL( Appointment_Date_Time__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Appointment Date Time field cannot be blank. Please enter the appointment date and time in this field, and a calendar event will be created for you.
